title: What an Elegant Bridge: Multilingual LLMs are Biased Similarly in Different Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting multilingual LLMs to describe inanimate nouns in languages with grammatical gender using adjectives, translating the generated adjectives to English, and training a binary classifier on the adjectives' word embeddings to predict the noun's grammatical gender. This measures whether the models disproportionately attribute stereotypically masculine or feminine characteristics to objects based solely on their grammatical gender.
